findings.description: Critical: The backend cannot recompute the promised dg-06 full-context digest from the contracted payload. The digest covers every assignment extension and optional provenance and must be recomputed before launch (`openspec/changes/add-dispatch-sandbox-enforcement/design.md:27-33`); dg-06 permits arbitrary assignment extensions and provenance (`openspec/changes/make-the-orchestrator-obey-the-router/contracts/routing-dispatch-context.schema.json:25-26,29-52`). However, `DispatchExecutionContext` is closed and carries only flattened known fields, without the original assignment object or provenance (`openspec/changes/add-dispatch-sandbox-enforcement/contracts/dispatch-execution-context.schema.json:6-37`). Carry the lossless dg-06 source document or canonical bytes in payload v2, validate flattened fields against it, and add extension/provenance tamper vectors.

Critical: Payload v2 retains duplicate, unbound authorities for execution identity. D1 and task 4.3 remove or compare only top-level isolation (`openspec/changes/add-dispatch-sandbox-enforcement/design.md:14-24`; `openspec/changes/add-dispatch-sandbox-enforcement/tasks.md:44-47`), while the current payload independently carries `provider`, `model`, and `agent_id` (`skills/autopilot/scripts/provider_dispatch.py:38-66`) and dispatch selects the provider and local CLI model from those fields (`skills/autopilot/scripts/provider_dispatch.py:474-504,614-646,721-753`). A stale or tampered payload can therefore launch a different lane or model while auditing the embedded immutable context. Make the context authoritative or reject every duplicated identity mismatch before launch.

Critical: The export orders priority descending (`openspec/changes/add-dispatch-sandbox-enforcement/specs/agent-coordinator/spec.md:15-18`; `openspec/changes/add-dispatch-sandbox-enforcement/design.md:112-117`), reversing the landed policy semantics where lower numbers have higher priority and evaluation uses `priority ASC` (`agent-coordinator/database/migrations/009_network_policies.sql:9-17,78-92`). Migration 044 does not migrate priority values or redefine their meaning. Preserve ascending priority or explicitly migrate every writer and reader atomically, with overlapping legacy-rule compatibility tests.

Critical: The production-process inventory remains incomplete despite the universal backend requirement (`openspec/changes/add-dispatch-sandbox-enforcement/specs/vendor-dispatch/spec.md:3-17`). D10 and `wp-vendor-wiring` include only Claude Code, Codex, and Pi evaluation backends (`openspec/changes/add-dispatch-sandbox-enforcement/design.md:262-266`; `openspec/changes/add-dispatch-sandbox-enforcement/work-packages.yaml:133-149,157-188`), but the live registry also supports Antigravity and Grok (`agent-coordinator/evaluation/backends/registry.py:14-31`), both of which directly spawn vendor processes (`agent-coordinator/evaluation/backends/antigravity.py:52-79`; `agent-coordinator/evaluation/backends/grok.py:102-131`). The configured OCR lane also launches a nested PATH-resolved vendor process (`skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/ocr_adapter.py:92-117`). Register and scope all three surfaces, and either route OCR through the backend or explicitly contract and test inherited-sandbox ownership. Also correct `agent-coordinator/tests/evaluation/**` to the real `agent-coordinator/tests/test_evaluation/**` path (`work-packages.yaml:182`).

Critical: Snapshot retries validate their root but not their content identity. The plan reuses the routing digest with a new snapshot root (`openspec/changes/add-dispatch-sandbox-enforcement/design.md:220-237`; `openspec/changes/add-dispatch-sandbox-enforcement/tasks.md:41-43`), while the current fallback creates the snapshot from committed `HEAD` and reruns there (`skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/review_dispatcher.py:2416-2429,2461-2485`). Untracked, staged, and unstaged content under review disappears, so a retry may succeed against a different tree. Require exact content materialization or reject fallback when parity cannot be proven, and bind the attempt to a content digest.

Critical: `work-packages.yaml` fails the repository's mandatory package validator. Its manual exact-SHA step lacks the required `manual_instructions` field (`openspec/changes/add-dispatch-sandbox-enforcement/work-packages.yaml:291-296`; requirement at `openspec/schemas/work-packages.schema.json:284-306`), and its terminal lock key ends in `terminal-integration`, which violates the canonical feature-lock suffix rule (`work-packages.yaml:269-273`; rule at `skills/validate-packages/scripts/validate_work_packages.py:56-66`). Fix both defects before dispatch; the current DAG cannot be accepted by package tooling.

Critical: `wp-validation-docs` cannot create the test its required verification command runs. Its scope permits the verifier module but excludes `skills/shared/tests/test_verify_sandbox_runtime_evidence.py` (`openspec/changes/add-dispatch-sandbox-enforcement/work-packages.yaml:223-230`), while its gate invokes that exact test (`work-packages.yaml:237-246`). Add the test path to this package's locks and write scope, or assign it explicitly to an earlier dependency.

Critical: Exact-pushed-SHA Linux/macOS evidence is not machine-enforced. The design requires verification of workflow path, exact head SHA, both platforms, artifact digest, and run identity (`openspec/changes/add-dispatch-sandbox-enforcement/design.md:275-287`; `openspec/changes/add-dispatch-sandbox-enforcement/tasks.md:65-68`), and the validation package plans a verifier (`work-packages.yaml:218-229`). The terminal gate is only a manual prose command with no evidence artifacts and does not invoke that verifier (`work-packages.yaml:291-297`). Make the post-push gate execute the verifier against downloaded artifacts and explicit workflow/run/head-SHA inputs, failing on missing platforms or identity/digest mismatch.

Nit: The vendor-wiring package claims all lifecycle surfaces but its package-local gate omits fact-check, phase-fixer, quick-task, and evaluation tests. Those paths are in its declared scope (`openspec/changes/add-dispatch-sandbox-enforcement/work-packages.yaml:124-127,157-188`), but its verification runs only a subset (`work-packages.yaml:194-203`). Add focused RED/GREEN commands for every registered surface so the owning package cannot report success while those migrations are broken.

Nit: `endpoint_digest` is required audit evidence but has no normative source document or canonicalization. The audit spec requires it while excluding raw endpoint credentials (`openspec/changes/add-dispatch-sandbox-enforcement/specs/agent-coordinator/spec.md:38-47`), and the event schema validates only a 64-character hexadecimal shape (`openspec/changes/add-dispatch-sandbox-enforcement/contracts/sandbox-execution-event.schema.json:35-38`). Define whether it hashes the normalized nullable base URL, how null is represented, how URI userinfo is excluded, and add golden parity tests.

Nit: The durable outbox has no size, record-count, drain-batch, lock-wait, retention, or dead-letter bounds and no required backlog telemetry. Every later event drains older records first (`openspec/changes/add-dispatch-sandbox-enforcement/design.md:167-190`), while tasks cover append, compaction, rejection, and drain behavior but not exhaustion (`openspec/changes/add-dispatch-sandbox-enforcement/tasks.md:15-20`). Define bounded drain work and endpoint timeouts, backlog/rotation and dead-letter retention policy, plus observable backlog depth, oldest age, drain failures, and dead-letter count.
